name: linkding
description: Bookmark manager that is fast, simple and good-looking

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Your bookmarks database, favicons, previews, saved web pages, the secret key and this install's admin password (.icestore-ld-superuser-password). Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: linkding web app and REST API, published on host as 6818

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: LD_SUPERUSER_NAME
variables.description: The admin user made on first start. The password is shown in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS.
